comment: KOTOR III (fan) Nar Shaddaa arrival. Seren sizes up the landing pad and names what the crew needs. Original writing for this fan project.

entries.text: So this is Nar Shaddaa. Loud, crowded, and every second face is already pricing us. My shuttle got us this far, but it would come apart on the long jump.
Two things. A navigator who knows the routes past the charts, and a ship with the range to fly them. The coordinates in the recording are useless without both.
Once, delivering a parcel I was told never to open. I never opened it. I am fairly sure that is the only reason I got to leave.
Start with the refugees around the pad. People who have lost everything tend to notice who is asking questions, and who is listening to the answers.
No. But she sent that recording home for a reason, and I have held on to it too long to put it down now. Ask me again once we have jumped.

replies.text: You sound like you have been here before.
Good instincts. So what do we need here?
Do you ever think about walking away?
